intro: Dawnwatcher Shaedlass is a night elf affiliated with the Argent Dawn, stationed within the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. Acting as a quiet eyes-and-ears operative in Kalimdor, he seeks news of his fellow order members sent on perilous reconnaissance into hostile lands.

p: While the Argent Dawn is most famous for its bitter crusade against the Scourge in the Eastern Plaguelands, its vigilance extends far beyond Lordaeron. Dawnwatcher Shaedlass maintains a presence in the night elven capital of Darnassus, watching over the faction's interests in Kalimdor. From his quiet post on the Craftsmen's Terrace, he keeps tabs on covert expeditions against dark cults and corrupting powers that threaten the wider world.
